passages.label: Applies to conventional first-lien applications
passages.text: This policy applies to all conventional first-lien mortgage applications submitted through the retail channel for owner-occupied primary residences.

passages.label: Salaried income and verification
passages.text: Qualifying income for salaried borrowers is the gross monthly base pay, verified by pay stubs covering the most recent 30 days and a written verification of employment dated within 10 business days of closing.

passages.label: Variable income inclusion
passages.text: Overtime, bonus and commission income may be included only when a two-year history is documented and the income is likely to continue. Where the documented history is under two years, written approval from a Credit Officer is required.

passages.label: Variable income calculation
passages.text: Qualifying income from overtime, bonus and commission is calculated as the sum of earnings over the preceding 24 months divided by 24.

passages.label: Maximum back-end DTI
passages.text: The maximum back-end debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is 45%. Ratios up to 50% are permitted with compensating factors approved by a Senior Underwriter.

passages.label: DTI definition
passages.text: DTI equals total monthly obligations divided by gross monthly qualifying income, expressed as a percentage.

passages.label: Handling DTI above 45%
passages.text: When DTI exceeds 45%, the underwriter must document at least two compensating factors, route the file to the Senior Underwriter queue, and record the decision in the loan file within one business day.

passages.label: Exceptions refer to guidelines not supplied
passages.text: Exceptions to this policy are handled in accordance with the exception handling guidelines.

passages.label: Reserve adequacy
passages.text: Reserves must be adequate for the loan type.

issues.title: Not machine-evaluable
issues.detail: The passage says reserves must be “adequate” without a threshold, unit or loan-type mapping. An agent cannot evaluate this card.
issues.fix: Add the reserve requirement to the source policy, or reject this card and record the gap.

issues.title: Possible conflict with R-003
issues.detail: C-004 averages 24 months of earnings, but R-003 allows inclusion with under 24 months of history when a Credit Officer approves. The divisor is undefined for that case.
issues.fix: Confirm the divisor for histories under 24 months, then add it as a condition on C-004.

issues.title: Unresolved reference

issues.title: Undefined term
issues.detail: “Compensating factors” is used by R-005 and P-007 but is not defined in this policy. An agent cannot check whether a factor qualifies.
